Corollary
[Mean value inequality for heat supersolutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0397 ↗ thm:chow-iii-ricci-flow-local-mean-value-monotonicity 1. ch26:26.45\group Ricci Flow Heat Balls

If $u\ge 0$ and $(\partial _t-\Delta )u\ge 0$, then (I(r)) is nonincreasing and \[ u(x_0,t_0)\ge \frac1{r^n}\iint _{E_r} (|\nabla \psi _r|^2+\psi _rR)u\, d\mu _{g(t)}dt. \]
